title: Improving Cross-lingual Information Retrieval on Low-Resource Languages via Optimal Transport Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) performance metrics such as Mean Average Precision (MAP) and Precision@10 (P@10) across high-resource and low-resource languages, as well as visualizing token representation alignment across languages using t-SNE to evaluate the performance gap.
